description: The Unity Nodes validator guide for Celestia (moved here from runcelestia.xyz): the path to an active validator in three phases, the ten setup steps, operator gotchas, and the FAQ and common errors with their fixes. Every item names the Celestia docs page it was checked against, says whether the docs or the chain confirm it (verified) or it is operator experience (partial), and records where the docs or the chain disagree with the guide: those win over the guide. For exact commands and requirements use the official docs (search or get_doc); for the live state of the network get_celestia_network_health and get_celestia_upgrade_status; for choosing a server list_datacenter_offers; for what Unity Nodes' own nodes measure get_celestia_hardware_usage.

query.description: Words or an error message from the logs, e.g. "app hash mismatch" or "how do I unjail". Most of the words must match.

section.description: journey: the path to an active validator; setup: the ten setup steps; gotcha: operator lessons; faq: questions and node errors with their fixes.

name: get_celestia_validator_guide
